say: Goal first: one new electric coupe in the classic GT language, outside and inside, plus three colourways.
The E-Type fixed-head: the long bonnet and fastback this coupe should keep.
There is no car lens, so I ask Muse to propose one from these references.
I write the new car in the board's own words: long bonnet, fastback, round glass-covered lamps, a blanked EV face, restrained chrome.
Same car, side profile: this is where the long bonnet and fastback must read.
Inside, the same language: wood rim and veneer from the E-Type cockpit, a slim screen from the Taycan.
The views disagree on one thing: the seats view has a black leather wheel, the dashboard view a wood rim. I change only that.
Colourways come from exploring the paint dimension, so each one changes the colour and nothing else.
Laying out the sheet: one row per deliverable, each picture captioned with why it is there.
Asking Muse to check the sheet again: every deliverable present, every render passed, and all of it one car.
